selectedScientificModel: Qualitative schematic of the explicitly idealized two-valence metal M/M2+/M(OH)2 model in case10b; not a real iron or complete metal/water diagram.
derivation: At fixed dissolved M2+ activity, M2+/M has no proton term and is horizontal in pE/pH. The M2+/M(OH)2 dissolution/precipitation boundary contains no electron term and is vertical. For M(OH)2 +2H+ +2e− -> M+2H2O, pE decreases with increasing pH; the hydroxide/metal boundary slopes down to the right. The three boundaries meet in one triple point. Metal is below the reducing boundary, dissolved M2+ above-left, hydroxide solid above-right.
